newsitem.title: UK: Sunderland drops after heavy league defeat.
newsitem.headline: Sunderland drops after heavy league defeat.

text.p: Sunderland Plc shares tumbled on Wednesday after the soccer club's four-nil defeat by Spurs last night, which left it languishing towards the bottom of the Premier league.
Sunderland shares, which joined the London stock market last December, were down 32-1/2p at 675 by 1440 GMT in thin volume of 10,852 shares.
The club ranks 16th out of 20 in the Premier league, just two places outside the relegation zone.
Tottenham Hotspur shares were unchanged at 112-1/2p.
Shares in UK league leaders Manchester United were up 2-1/2p at 647-1/2 ahead of the club's Champion's League encounter with Porto tonight.
